title: The Reasoning Lingua Franca: A Double-Edged Sword for Multilingual AI

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing final-answer accuracy and the frequency of cognitive behaviors (such as sub-goal setting and verification) in reasoning traces when models are prompted to reason in English versus the question's native language. The study also measures the performance gap across high-resource and low-resource languages and quantifies 'Lost in Translation' errors caused by forcing models to reason in English.
